labels.name: SavedBiosVideoMode
labels.comment: Byte from BIOS AH=0Fh with bit 7 cleared, restored by the DOS exit path.

labels.name: PreviousKeyboardVector
labels.comment: Saved INT 09h far pointer, offset then segment; restored with LDS DX.

labels.name: PreviousKeyboardVectorSegment
labels.comment: Segment-word view of the previous INT 09h far pointer.

labels.name: KeyboardHandlerVector
labels.comment: New INT 09h far pointer passed to DOS AH=25h by installation.

labels.name: DecodedImagePointer
labels.comment: Far scratch-image pointer consumed by the chunky-to-VGA uploader.

labels.name: CurrentTileMapPointer
labels.comment: DGROUP far pointer consumed by DrawTileMap for 320 byte tile IDs in row-major order.

labels.name: CompressedTileMapsPointer
labels.comment: Far pointer to ICE-compressed tile maps; 072A decompresses and selects a 320-byte map.

labels.name: TimerBarPointer
labels.comment: DGROUP far VGA pointer to timer bar; three rows at offsets 0,96,192 are written.

labels.name: BasePalettePointer
labels.comment: Far pointer used as duplicate-palette destination and full-DAC upload source.

labels.name: FadedPalettePointer
labels.comment: Far pointer used as source for the scaled-palette range upload.

labels.name: PaletteSourcePointer
labels.comment: Far palette source; 466Ah reads its first 384 bytes and duplicates them.

labels.name: LevelWorkspacePointer
labels.comment: DGROUP far pointer to the 392-byte range zeroed during level display initialization.

labels.name: HighScoreFileHandle
labels.comment: DOS score-file handle, shared by load/save; stale values are retained after close/failure.

labels.name: DecimalTenDivisor
labels.comment: Byte divisor ten used by the numeric two-digit encoder.

labels.name: DecimalHundredDivisor
labels.comment: Byte divisor one hundred used by the numeric four-digit encoder.

labels.name: DecimalThousandDivisor
labels.comment: Word divisor one thousand used by the numeric four-digit encoder.

labels.name: DecimalTenThousandDivisor
labels.comment: Word divisor ten thousand used by the numeric six-digit encoder.

labels.name: VgaRowStrideBytes
labels.comment:
DGROUP word holding the unchained VGA byte stride, initialized to 96 (060h).
Water routines multiply by its low byte using unsigned MUL r/m8, consuming AL, not AX.

labels.name: TimerBarDivisor
labels.comment: Word divisor 700 converting remaining timer units to bar columns.

labels.name: HighScoreRowStride
labels.comment: Byte high-score row stride, initially 21; 043A/0446 multiply unsigned CL by this value.

labels.name: DecimalDigitBuffer
labels.comment:
Start of a seven-byte decimal work buffer: six digits plus FFh from 3F0F.
0210 converts six digits to ASCII with leading spaces; 0664 reuses its first two digits.

labels.name: DecimalDigit1
labels.comment: Decimal work-buffer digit at byte index 1; 0664 uses it for the level-number units digit.

labels.name: DecimalDigit2
labels.comment: Decimal work-buffer digit/score character at byte index 2, compared by 0452.

labels.name: DecimalDigit3
labels.comment: Decimal work-buffer digit/score character at byte index 3, compared by 0452.

labels.name: DecimalDigit4
labels.comment: Decimal work-buffer digit/score character at byte index 4, compared by 0452.

labels.name: DecimalDigit5
labels.comment: Decimal work-buffer digit/score character at byte index 5, compared by 0452.

labels.name: DifficultyLabelPointers
labels.comment: Three near pointers: EASY, MEDIUM, HARD.

labels.name: PlayerCountLabelPointers
labels.comment: Two near pointers: player-count labels.

labels.name: ControlModeLabelPointers
labels.comment: Three near pointers: control labels, indexed by selector+1.

labels.name: PasswordListPointers
labels.comment: Two near pointers: one-player and two-player password lists.

labels.name: PasswordCompareBiasedBase
labels.comment:
Biased password comparison view, one byte before the input at 0B4E; not a separate buffer.
RunGameFromPassword increments BX before reading this base+BX; trailing input must be spaces.

labels.name: PasswordEditBuffer
labels.comment: Mutable 20-byte password field within the main-menu text; space padded, without its own NUL.

labels.name: PasswordEditChars2To3
labels.comment: Word view of password characters 2..3 (zero based); empty-entry handling writes 'NE' here.

labels.name: LevelNumberTensCharacter
labels.comment: Mutable ASCII tens character in the centered LEVEL 00 line; set by 0664.

labels.name: LevelNumberUnitsCharacter
labels.comment: Mutable ASCII units character in the centered LEVEL 00 line; set by 0664.

labels.name: HighScoreNameEntry
labels.comment:
Twelve-byte mutable high-score name field within the prompt text, followed by its NUL.
Empty input writes INCOGNITUS plus two spaces; stored names have two further padding bytes.

labels.name: HighScoreNameChars2To3
labels.comment: Word view of high-score name characters 2..3 (zero based); default-name store writes 'CO'.

labels.name: HighScoreNameChars4To5
labels.comment: Word view of high-score name characters 4..5 (zero based); default-name store writes 'GN'.

labels.name: HighScoreNameChars6To7
labels.comment: Word view of high-score name characters 6..7 (zero based); default-name store writes 'IT'.

labels.name: HighScoreNameChars8To9
labels.comment: Word view of high-score name characters 8..9 (zero based); default-name store writes 'US'.

labels.name: HighScoreRows
labels.comment:
Five 21-byte high-score rows: 14 name/padding bytes, six score characters, then CR.
Two trailing bytes 00h/FFh extend the complemented/saved block to 107 bytes.

labels.name: PlayerAnimationCycleStarts
labels.comment: Word view of cycle starts indexed by player byte index 0/2; shares boundary at 0CFC.

labels.name: PlayerAnimationCycleEnds
labels.comment: Word view of exclusive frame-cycle ends indexed by player byte index 0/2.

labels.name: VgaSinglePlaneMasks
labels.comment: Four bytes 1,2,4,8 selecting one timer-bar pixel plane.

labels.name: VgaCumulativePlaneMasks
labels.comment: Four bytes 1,3,7,15 selecting planes through the final growing timer-bar column.

labels.name: CurrentLevelIndex
labels.comment:
Zero-based level index used for password lookup and level selection; displayed as index+1.
0C07 assigns the password's ordinal (or zero on failure), and 0FD3 increments on progression.

labels.name: ScoreLowWord
labels.comment: Low word of the shared unsigned 32-bit score; ADD here pairs with ADC at 2620.

labels.name: ScoreHighWord
labels.comment: High word of the shared unsigned 32-bit score; carries come from 261E.

labels.name: LevelTimer
labels.comment: Signed word countdown; initialized 23099, negative means expired; bar divides by 700.

labels.name: LevelCountsByPlayerMode
labels.comment:
Two word level-count limits selected by twice-player-count minus 2; initially 69 and 81.
Main-menu return handling at 0162 compares the current level index against the chosen limit.

labels.name: MultiplierLimitsByDifficulty
labels.comment: Three u16 limits indexed by difficulty*2; 1A7E gates multiplier-pickup creation.

labels.name: PlayerImpactLimits
labels.comment:
Three difficulty-selected word limits for PlayerImpactMagnitude: 3100,2300,1380 decimal.
Signed comparisons gate platform attachment and start the impact fade at equality or above.

labels.name: PlayerCount
labels.comment: Word count 1 or 2; some collision loops compare this against byte index 2.

labels.name: PlayerArrayBytes
labels.comment: Word equal to PlayerCount*2; proper parallel-player loops use it as end byte index.

labels.name: SelectedDifficulty
labels.comment: Difficulty choice 0/1/2; menu F3 cycles it and table DA displays EASY/MEDIUM/HARD.

labels.name: LivesRemaining
labels.comment:
Shared byte life count: new game writes 3; collected kind-1 items add and cap at 99.
Retry path 0FBCh decrements it and stops at zero or a negative result; byte wrapping matters.

labels.name: ScoreMultiplier
labels.comment:
Packed multiplier: reset and pickup write a byte, but pickup and scoring read a word here.
Kind-2 items increment below difficulty limit; passenger delivery at 1AABh multiplies score.
Preserve the adjacent high byte at 263Eh and the original widths, rather than widening stores.

labels.name: PlayerOneControlMode
labels.comment: Player 1 control selector: -1 keyboard, 0 joystick A, 1 joystick B; menu table E4 uses value+1.

labels.name: PlayerTwoControlMode
labels.comment: Player 2 control selector with the same -1/0/1 encoding as player 1.

labels.name: CurrentKeyboardScanCode
labels.comment:
Latest sampled keyboard make/break scan-code byte, returned in AL by PollPlayerControls.
Keyboard sampling copies it to the previous-byte cell before replacing it with the ISR byte.

labels.name: PreviousPolledScanCode
labels.comment: Old scan byte saved by 44F1h before replacing the current sample.

labels.name: KeyboardScanCodeChangeBits
labels.comment:
Byte XOR of current and previous keyboard scan codes, returned in AH by PollPlayerControls.
Nonzero detects a change of code, including break codes; this is not a key-down boolean.

labels.name: KeyboardSequenceIndex
labels.comment: Byte index into raw-scan prefixes shared by all candidate records; reset on match.

labels.name: CoordinateScaleScratch
labels.comment: DGROUP shared word holding signed coordinate quarter or speed half; not reentrant.

labels.name: DemoExitCode
labels.comment:
Word demo exit code: FFFF for Q, 1 for Escape, zero for completion or other input.
RunScriptedDemo returns SF/ZF from TEST of this word; AX need not contain it.

labels.name: PlayerUpInput
labels.comment:
Two player up-action words, byte index BX=0/2; nonzero requests upward thrust.
Joystick mapping writes 0/FFFF words; the keyboard interrupt writes one byte within each word.

labels.name: PlayerDownInput
labels.comment:
Two player down-action words; joystick positive-Y selection sets FFFF, idle clears to zero.
Underwater movement adds downward thrust when nonzero; keyboard updates have byte width.

labels.name: PlayerLeftInput
labels.comment:
Two player left-action words; nonzero subtracts horizontal thrust in player movement.
Joystick mapping writes whole words, while the keyboard interrupt updates action bytes.

labels.name: PlayerRightInput
labels.comment:
Two player right-action words; nonzero adds horizontal thrust unless left action took precedence.
Joystick mapping writes whole words, while the keyboard interrupt updates action bytes.

labels.name: PlayerActionInput
labels.comment:
Two player action-button words; joystick mapping sets FFFF when either button bit is active.
Actor interaction at 1C6F reads a byte; preserve mixed byte/word consumers and keyboard writes.

labels.name: WaterRestorePending
labels.comment:
Byte flag for a second restoration of the previous water row after the boundary changes.
AdvanceWaterSurface writes FFh on movement; the next call clears it and skips movement.

labels.name: WaterSurfaceFrameCountdown
labels.comment:
Byte countdown decremented for each water-surface draw; a negative result reloads 6.
Expiry also decrements WaterSurfaceFrame, wrapping a negative frame to 2.

labels.name: WaterSurfaceFrame
labels.comment:
Word selecting one of three CS near frame targets; expected 0..2, decremented at expiry.
DrawWaterSurface doubles this value for dispatch, with no bounds check.

labels.name: CachedTimerBarWidth
labels.comment: Word cached timer/700 column count; updated even when shrink clears only one column.

labels.name: ScreenFadeLevel
labels.comment:
Signed word palette-fade accumulator; 0..100h is passed to the palette scaling helper.
Values above 100h pace at retrace without scaling; a negative value ends demo/game fade loops.

labels.name: ScreenFadeStep
labels.comment:
Signed word per-frame palette-fade step; demos use +4/-4, gameplay initialization uses +2.
Impact/completion/abort paths set -2; several callers immediately add the new step to the level.

labels.name: HudDigitCursorX
labels.comment: Word pixel X advanced by six for every compared digit, including unchanged digits.

labels.name: HudDigitCursorY
labels.comment: Word pixel Y for numeric HUD sprites; initialized and refreshed to 194.

labels.name: HudLivesX
labels.comment: Word X position for the two-digit counter read from 263C.

labels.name: HudScoreX
labels.comment: Word X position for the six-digit score at 261E:2620.

labels.name: HudLevelCounterX
labels.comment: Word X position for the two-digit level-record byte at 28F1; no stronger meaning claimed.

labels.name: HudPlayerOneIconX
labels.comment: Word X for sprite B2h plus player-one passenger/icon state 27FC.

labels.name: HudPlayerOneDestinationX
labels.comment: Word X for sprite B7h plus player-one destination/icon index 2804.

labels.name: HudFareX
labels.comment: Word X for the four-digit active passenger fare at 2808 or 280A; zeroed after unload.

labels.name: HudMultiplierX
labels.comment: Word X for the two-digit counter 263D, also used as a score multiplier outside region.

labels.name: HudPlayerTwoIconX
labels.comment: Word X for sprite BFh plus player-two passenger/icon state 27FE; two-player layout only.

labels.name: HudPlayerTwoDestinationX
labels.comment: Word X for sprite C4h plus player-two destination/icon index 2806.

labels.name: HudCachedScoreLow
labels.comment: Low word of prior displayed score; six-digit comparison pairs this with 27C4.

labels.name: HudCachedScoreHigh
labels.comment: High word of prior displayed score; deliberately altered during initialization.

labels.name: HudCachedFare
labels.comment: Word prior displayed four-digit fare; initialized to 9999 to force redraw.

labels.name: HudCachedMultiplier
labels.comment: Byte prior displayed counter from 263D; initialized by adding eleven modulo 100 once.

labels.name: HudCachedLives
labels.comment: Byte prior displayed counter from 263C; initialized by adding eleven modulo 100 once.

labels.name: HudCachedLevelCounter
labels.comment: Byte prior displayed level-record counter 28F1; initialized to 99.

labels.name: HudFareClearPending
labels.comment: Byte requests zeroing the fare after no player carries a passenger; cleared after handling.

labels.name: WaterStepPhase
labels.comment:
Byte phase toggled with XOR 1 whenever water update is not handling a pending restore.
Only zero after the toggle applies WaterSurfaceStep to fixed-point Y at 28FEh.

labels.name: LevelCompletionMarker
labels.comment:
Signed byte completion marker, set to FE by the final actor-itinerary completion path at 14C7.
RunGameFromPassword tests its sign to choose next level versus life decrement; setup clears it.

labels.name: PlayerX32
labels.comment: Two signed position words in 1/32-pixel units, indexed by player byte index 0 or 2.

labels.name: PlayerTwoFixedX
labels.comment: Second player fixed X initialized from start X minus 512; 1/32-pixel units.

labels.name: PlayerY32
labels.comment: Two signed position words in 1/32-pixel units; carried/impact geometry uses this anchor.

labels.name: PlayerTwoFixedY
labels.comment: Second player fixed Y initialized from scaled start Y minus 320; 1/32-pixel units.

labels.name: PlayerPixelX
labels.comment: Two parallel signed word pixel X values, selected by byte index 0 or 2.

labels.name: PlayerTwoPixelX
labels.comment: Second word of PlayerPixelX, initialized by arithmetic shifting fixed X right five.

labels.name: PlayerYPixels
labels.comment: Two cached pixel Y words derived by SAR 5; surface pickup requires water Y minus 18.

labels.name: SecondPlayerYPixels
labels.comment: Second element of PlayerYPixels; explicit second-player read occurs at 2016.

labels.name: PlayerCachedPixelX
labels.comment: Two prior pixel X values for restoring the previous frame on each draw page.

labels.name: PlayerTwoCachedPixelX
labels.comment: Second word of PlayerCachedPixelX; initialized to the start pixel X.

labels.name: PlayerCachedPixelY
labels.comment: Two prior pixel Y values for restoring the previous frame on each draw page.

labels.name: PlayerTwoCachedPixelY
labels.comment: Second word of PlayerCachedPixelY; initialized to the start pixel Y.

labels.name: PlayerSpriteIds
labels.comment: Two current player animation sprite IDs; advanced between per-player cycle boundaries.

labels.name: PlayerTwoSpriteId
labels.comment: Second word of PlayerSpriteIds; initialized to E0h.

labels.name: PlayerCachedSpriteIds
labels.comment: Two previous player sprite IDs used for restoration rectangle dimensions.

labels.name: PlayerAnimationCountdowns
labels.comment: Two signed countdown words; negative values add 200 and advance the sprite once.

labels.name: PlayerTwoAnimationCountdown
labels.comment: Second word of PlayerAnimationCountdowns; initialized to FFFFh.

labels.name: PlayerThrustAnimationRate
labels.comment:
Two per-player words accumulating thrust's animation contribution during one movement update.
Movement adds 3Fh or 5Ah; player drawing caps the rate at 5Ah before advancing its frame timer.

labels.name: PlayerPlatformIndices
labels.comment: Two words: platform index or FFFF for airborne/unattached; not byte indices.

labels.name: PlayerCarriedKinds
labels.comment: Two words: zero empty, descriptor +46 for passenger/stone; stone is kind four.

labels.name: PlayerTwoPassengerIconState
labels.comment: Second player load/icon state; zero disables its fare selection, BFh+value selects icon.

labels.name: HudCachedPlayerOneIconState
labels.comment: Word cached passenger/icon state 27FC; change redraws both first-player icons.

labels.name: HudCachedPlayerTwoIconState
labels.comment: Word cached passenger/icon state 27FE; initialized FFFFh; two-player HUD only.

labels.name: PlayerDestinationIcons
labels.comment: Two HUD icon indices: destination platform mapping, seven for stone, zero when empty.

labels.name: PlayerTwoDestinationIconIndex
labels.comment: Second player destination/icon index; HUD draws C4h+value when load state changes.

labels.name: PlayerPassengerFares
labels.comment: Two unsigned fare words; decrease toward minimum while passenger is carried.

labels.name: PlayerTwoFare
labels.comment: Second player fare; selected for four-digit display only when player one carries no passenger.

labels.name: PlayerMinimumFares
labels.comment: Two unsigned fare floors from descriptor +42; compared unsigned by 1A42.

labels.name: PlayerHorizontalVelocities
labels.comment: Two signed motion accumulators; player movement divides by 64 using SAR 6.

labels.name: PlayerVerticalVelocities
labels.comment: Two signed motion accumulators; player movement divides by 64 using SAR 6.

labels.name: PlayerImpactMagnitude
labels.comment:
Two per-player impact-magnitude words, reset on each movement call and filled by collisions.
Keeps the greater horizontal/vertical reflected magnitude for landing and difficulty-limit tests.

labels.name: KeyboardSequenceRecords
labels.comment: Six-byte records: three scan/FF bytes, action index/value, candidate state; FF sentinel.

labels.name: KeyboardSequenceNextScan
labels.comment: Record+1 view used with the shared index to detect the sequence-end FF byte.

labels.name: KeyboardSequenceActionIndex
labels.comment: Record+3 action-byte index; bit 1 also chooses the player control-sign gate.

labels.name: KeyboardSequenceActionValue
labels.comment: Record+4 byte copied to the selected action slot on a completed sequence.

labels.name: KeyboardSequenceCandidateState
labels.comment: Record+5: FF rejects a candidate, zero resets it; six-byte stride.

labels.name: CurrentLevelRecord
labels.comment: Base of 26-byte copied level record; first word is offset into decompressed tile-map bank.

labels.name: LevelPlatformList
labels.comment: Near pointer from current record to platform records; signed-negative first word terminates.

labels.name: LevelActorList
labels.comment: Near pointer from current record to actor placement triples; descriptor FFFFh terminates.

labels.name: LevelEnemyList
labels.comment: Near pointer from current record to descriptor-dependent enemy placements, FFFFh terminated.

labels.name: RemainingPassengerJourneys
labels.comment: Byte objective counter copied in the level record; exhausted itineraries decrement it.

labels.name: LevelIntroTextPointer
labels.comment:
Near pointer to current level's instruction/title text; 0664 draws the whole text block.
Part of the packed 26-byte level record copied to 28E9; this word is at byte offset 0Ah.

labels.name: LevelRainDirection
labels.comment: Byte rain mode: zero disables effect, one enters from right/moves left, two the opposite.

labels.name: LevelPlayerOneStartX
labels.comment: Record word start X in 1/32 units before subtracting the 16-pixel player X origin.

labels.name: LevelPlayerOneStartY
labels.comment: Record word start Y before signed three-quarter scaling and ten-pixel Y origin subtraction.

labels.name: LevelPlayerTwoStartX
labels.comment: Record word second-player start X; initialized even in single-player mode.

labels.name: LevelPlayerTwoStartY
labels.comment: Record word second-player start Y; signed three-quarter conversion precedes origin adjustment.

labels.name: WaterY32
labels.comment: Word water surface coordinate in 1/32-pixel units after level initialization.

labels.name: WaterSurfaceStep
labels.comment:
Signed word increment for fixed-point water Y at 28FEh, in 1/32 pixel units.
Copied as part of the level record; AdvanceWaterSurface applies it on alternate phase zero.

labels.name: WaterYPixels
labels.comment: Word water surface pixel Y; actor immersion and floating pickup tests use it.

labels.name: PreviousWaterSurfaceY
labels.comment:
Word containing the prior water pixel row; refreshed before each non-pending water update.
Used for the color-bit toggle and both old-row restorations after movement.

labels.name: WaterSurfaceByteOffset
labels.comment:
Word row offset, without VGA page base: low-byte water pixel Y times low-byte row stride.
DrawWaterSurface writes it; rain advancement at 3CC2h clips byte offsets against it.

labels.name: LevelOrderTables
labels.comment: Two near pointers indexed by (playerCount-1)*2; selected table is indexed by level*2.

labels.name: PlatformLeftEdges
labels.comment: Ten signed pixel X bounds; FFFF terminates platform scans through this parallel array.

labels.name: PlatformRightEdges
labels.comment: Ten pixel X bounds; stone landing uses inclusive bounds; patrol uses its own strict test.

labels.name: PlatformHeights
labels.comment: Ten pixel Y values after aspect conversion; actor feet snap to these on landing.

labels.name: PlatformArrivalPointsX
labels.comment: Ten pixel X anchors used for passenger appearance and post-delivery departure.

labels.name: PlatformWaitingPointsX
labels.comment: Ten pixel X anchors passengers approach while waiting for a vehicle.

labels.name: PlatformSpawnX
labels.comment: Word platform X values used to place actors/enemies after subtracting sprite origin offsets.

labels.name: PlatformDestinationIcons
labels.comment: Ten words mapping destination platform to the carried passenger HUD icon index.

labels.name: PlatformActorOccupants
labels.comment: Ten actor byte indices; FFFF means unclaimed; appearance claims, boarding frees.

labels.name: ActorDescriptors
labels.comment: Sixteen near DGROUP descriptor pointers; FFFF terminates the active actor list.

labels.name: ActorInitialPlatformIndices
labels.comment: Parallel actor word copied from placement; special descriptor 78DCh uses it as platform index.

labels.name: ActorJourneyCursors
labels.comment: Sixteen near journey pointers; current leg has source, delay, destination words.

labels.name: ActorUpdateOrScriptCursor
labels.comment: Sixteen near GAME callbacks in gameplay, or near DGROUP cursors in demo scripts.

labels.name: ds_2A2D
labels.comment:
Polymorphic actor scratch: wait mode, state timer, carrier byte index, or demo loop cursor.
Effects: interpret per active callback/script; no single scalar role is established.

labels.name: DemoCompletionScanBiasedBase
labels.comment:
Biased view two bytes before the demo completion-word array at 2A4D; no separate allocation.
TestAllDemoScriptsFinished increments BX before testing this base+BX for the prior script slot.

labels.name: ActorPlatformOrScriptDone
labels.comment: Sixteen words: current/source platform in gameplay; demo completion flag otherwise.

labels.name: ActorDestinationPlatforms
labels.comment: Sixteen destination platform indices read from journey cursor +4.

labels.name: ActorSourcePlatformByteIndices
labels.comment: Sixteen source platform indices multiplied by two for parallel-array indexing.

labels.name: ActorDestinationPlatformByteIndices
labels.comment: Sixteen destination indices multiplied by two for parallel-array indexing.

labels.name: ds_2ACD
labels.comment:
Polymorphic actor scratch: journey delay, thrown X speed, floating lifetime, demo repeat count.
Effects: interpret per active callback/script; no single scalar role is established.

labels.name: ActorX32
labels.comment: Sixteen signed positions in 1/32-pixel units; walking adds/subtracts 20h.

labels.name: ActorY32
labels.comment: Sixteen signed positions in 1/32-pixel units; thrown and waterborne actors update these.

labels.name: ActorPixelX
labels.comment: Sixteen cached pixel X values; renderer updates these using ActorX32 SAR 5.

labels.name: ActorPreviousDrawX
labels.comment:
Sixteen actor/demo previous-draw X words in pixels; rotated from current pixel X before drawing.
The erase pass restores the background rectangle at this older position for each buffered page.

labels.name: ActorPixelY
labels.comment: Sixteen cached pixel Y values; water tests may use the preceding render's value.

labels.name: ActorPreviousDrawY
labels.comment:
Sixteen actor/demo previous-draw Y words in pixels; paired with ActorPreviousDrawX for erasing.
These are parallel word arrays; demo initialization copies each starting Y here too.

labels.name: ActorAnimationByteOffsets
labels.comment: Sixteen word offsets into sprite vectors; FFFE initialization precedes a +2 step.

labels.name: ActorAnimationCountdowns
labels.comment: Sixteen word update countdowns; frame advance occurs only when DEC reaches zero.

labels.name: ActorSpriteIds
labels.comment: Sixteen current sprites; FFFF is hidden in gameplay, 7FFF is hidden in demo rendering.

labels.name: ActorEraseSprite
labels.comment:
Sixteen actor/demo sprite IDs used for background erasure; exchanged with current IDs each pass.
FFFF skips erasure; demo erasure also skips hidden ID 7FFF. ResetSpriteEraseState writes FFFF.

labels.name: ActorOverlayOrScriptCallbacks
labels.comment: Sixteen overlay sprites in gameplay; near GAME callbacks during demo interpretation.

labels.name: ActorEraseOverlaySprite
labels.comment:
Sixteen actor overlay erase-sprite IDs, rotated from the live overlay field at 2C2D.
The game erases these at actor previous X+11 and Y-13 decimal; FFFF suppresses erasure.

labels.name: ds_2C6D
labels.comment:
Polymorphic actor scratch: vertical speed in gameplay but update period in demo scripts.
Effects: interpret per active callback/script; no single scalar role is established.

labels.name: PassengerQuickDeliveryCountdowns
labels.comment: Sixteen words; boarding sets 200, carrying decrements positives, delivery tests nonzero.

labels.name: EnemyDescriptors
labels.comment: Five near DGROUP descriptor pointers; FFFF terminates enemy dispatch.

labels.name: EnemyPlatformIndices
labels.comment: Five platform indices used by the dinosaur and tree placement/state paths.

labels.name: EnemyX32
labels.comment: Five signed positions in 1/32-pixel units; bird flight and dinosaur charge update them.

labels.name: EnemyY32
labels.comment: Five signed positions in 1/32-pixel units; stone collision tests compare against these.

labels.name: EnemyAnimationOrDropLists
labels.comment: Five near DGROUP pointers: bird animation vector, or tree falling-reward descriptor list.

labels.name: EnemyInitialDelays
labels.comment: Five word delays; bird initialization copies its value into the active state countdown.

labels.name: EnemyHorizontalSpeeds
labels.comment: Five signed horizontal increments; patrol/flight reverse signs and charge adds acceleration.

labels.name: EnemyStateCallbacks
labels.comment: Five near GAME callbacks called by 2363 with BX retained as enemy byte index.

labels.name: EnemyStateCounters
labels.comment: Five words reused as delays/stun timers, bird falling acceleration, or charge acceleration.

labels.name: EnemyDrawX
labels.comment:
Five enemy current-draw X words in pixels; game rendering fills them from signed fixed X SAR 5.
Previous values rotate into EnemyPreviousDrawX for background restoration.

labels.name: EnemyPreviousDrawX
labels.comment: Five enemy previous-draw X words in pixels, used by the erasure pass at 0D34.

labels.name: EnemyDrawY
labels.comment:
Five enemy current-draw Y words in pixels; game rendering fills them from signed fixed Y SAR 5.
Previous values rotate into EnemyPreviousDrawY for background restoration.

labels.name: EnemyPreviousDrawY
labels.comment: Five enemy previous-draw Y words in pixels, paired with EnemyPreviousDrawX for erasure.

labels.name: EnemyAnimationByteOffsets
labels.comment: Five word sprite-vector byte offsets; FFFE initialization precedes +2 frame stepping.

labels.name: EnemyAnimationCountdowns
labels.comment: Five word update countdowns; frame cadence varies by enemy state.

labels.name: EnemySpriteIds
labels.comment: Five current sprite words; FFFF hides the enemy.

labels.name: EnemyEraseSprite
labels.comment: Five enemy erase-sprite words, rotated from current sprite IDs at 2D43; FFFF skips erasure.

labels.name: EnemyDirectionOrTargetPlayer
labels.comment: Five words: bird target player number 0/1, or dinosaur animation offset 0/2.

labels.name: EnemyFlightSoundHandles
labels.comment: Five word C sound-channel handles; bird flight stores one and 25A0 stops it.

labels.name: FallingItemDescriptors
labels.comment:
Twelve near descriptor-pointer words, indexed by even slot byte offset 0..16h.
Spawn initializes a slot; flight, landing and collection consume its 20-byte descriptor.

labels.name: FallingItemCallbacks
labels.comment:
Twelve near GAME callback words for falling-item slots; dispatcher calls active slots.
Spawn selects descriptor+6 (flight), landing switches to descriptor+0Ah (pickup).

labels.name: FallingItemSprites
labels.comment:
Twelve sprite-ID words: FFFFh disables dispatch/rendering and marks the usual free slot.
Allocation accepts any negative word; spawn takes descriptor+10h as the sprite ID.

labels.name: FallingItemEraseSprite
labels.comment:
Twelve falling-item erase-sprite words, rotated from current IDs at 2D9B; FFFF skips erasure.
This DGROUP array is unrelated to the GAME CS jump table at the same numerical offset.

labels.name: FallingItemX
labels.comment:
Twelve signed X-position words in 1/32 pixel units, indexed by even item slot byte offset.
Spawn subtracts descriptor[0]<<5; flight adds horizontal step, with signed offscreen limits.

labels.name: FallingItemY
labels.comment:
Twelve signed Y-position words in 1/32 pixel units, indexed by even item slot byte offset.
Spawn subtracts height<<4; flight adds vertical step; landing snaps using height<<5.

labels.name: FallingItemDrawX
labels.comment: Twelve falling-item current-draw X words in pixels; each draw derives them from fixed X SAR 5.

labels.name: FallingItemPreviousDrawX
labels.comment: Twelve falling-item previous-draw X words in pixels, copied before drawing and consumed by erase.

labels.name: FallingItemDrawY
labels.comment: Twelve falling-item current-draw Y words in pixels; each draw derives them from fixed Y SAR 5.

labels.name: FallingItemPreviousDrawY
labels.comment: Twelve falling-item previous-draw Y words in pixels, paired with FallingItemPreviousDrawX.

labels.name: FallingItemMotionOrLifetime
labels.comment:
Twelve state-dependent words: horizontal step during flight, countdown after landing.
Spawn stores CX; landing replaces it with 0230h; pickup predecrements to equality zero.

labels.name: FallingItemVerticalStep
labels.comment:
Twelve vertical-step words, in 1/32 pixel units per update, positive downward.
Spawn writes -(launch term+descriptor[0Ch]); flight adds gravity 3 with word wrapping.

labels.name: RainParticleOffsets
labels.comment: 193 current VGA byte offsets; level initialization clears all and optionally seeds them.

labels.name: RainPreviousOffsets
labels.comment: 193 previous VGA byte offsets retained before particle motion and used by restoration.

labels.name: RainParticleXModuloFour
labels.comment: 193 word plane indices (X modulo four), stored separately from particle byte offsets.

labels.name: JoystickPresentFlags
labels.comment:
Start of two word joystick-presence flags: negative permits selection in control options.
50C6 initializes them to zero, then writes FFFFh after the corresponding port-201h test.

labels.name: SecondJoystickPresent
labels.comment: Second-stick presence word: zero initially, FFFFh if port bits 2/3 discharge.

labels.name: FirstJoystickXCount
labels.comment: Software count for port-201h bit 0; horizontal thresholds consumed by 0FE8h.

labels.name: SecondJoystickXCount
labels.comment: Software count for port-201h bit 2; parallel to first-stick X count.

labels.name: FirstJoystickYCount
labels.comment: Software count for port-201h bit 1; vertical thresholds consumed by 0FE8h.

labels.name: SecondJoystickYCount
labels.comment: Software count for port-201h bit 3; parallel to first-stick Y count.

labels.name: JoystickButtonBits
labels.comment:
Two joystick button-mask words: stick zero bits 30h, stick one bits C0h, active high after NOT.
Any set bit maps to the corresponding player's action input; preserve these as bitmasks.

labels.name: SecondJoystickButtonBits
labels.comment: Active-high port bits C0h, stored as a word after a separate IN from first stick.

labels.name: FirstJoystickXDoubleCenter
labels.comment: Twice the first-stick X calibration sample, wrapping at 16 bits; timeout candidate.

labels.name: SecondJoystickXDoubleCenter
labels.comment: Twice the second-stick X calibration sample; unsigned timeout candidate.

labels.name: FirstJoystickYDoubleCenter
labels.comment: Twice the first-stick Y calibration sample; unsigned timeout candidate.

labels.name: SecondJoystickYDoubleCenter
labels.comment: Twice the second-stick Y calibration sample; unsigned timeout candidate.

labels.name: JoystickLeftThresholds
labels.comment:
Two joystick X low-threshold words; measured X <= threshold selects left, with signed comparison.
Calibration uses center - floor(center/2); each stick's word is two bytes apart.

labels.name: SecondJoystickXLowThreshold
labels.comment: ceil(center/2) for the second-stick X count; compared with signed branches at 0FE8h.

labels.name: JoystickRightThresholds
labels.comment:
Two joystick X high-threshold words; measured X >= threshold selects right if left did not win.
Calibration uses center + floor(center/2); preserve signed comparisons and endpoint equality.

labels.name: SecondJoystickXHighThreshold
labels.comment: center+floor(center/2) for second-stick X; arithmetic wraps to 16 bits.

labels.name: JoystickUpThresholds
labels.comment:
Two joystick Y low-threshold words; measured Y <= threshold selects up, with signed comparison.
Calibration uses center - floor(center/2); each stick's word is two bytes apart.

labels.name: SecondJoystickYLowThreshold
labels.comment: ceil(center/2) for the second-stick Y count; low-direction threshold.

labels.name: JoystickDownThresholds
labels.comment:
Two joystick Y high-threshold words; measured Y >= threshold selects down if up did not win.
Calibration uses center + floor(center/2); preserve signed comparisons and endpoint equality.

labels.name: SecondJoystickYHighThreshold
labels.comment: center+floor(center/2) for second-stick Y; high-direction threshold.

labels.name: JoystickEnabledAxisMask
labels.comment: Byte: bits 0/1 enable stick one and 2/3 stick two; sampler masks other axes.

labels.name: JoystickSampleLoopLimit
labels.comment: Word maximum of four doubled center counts, initially FFFFh during detection.
